youtube.title: London's Wildest Rivals to the Eiffel Tower (1890) #Shorts
youtube.description:
In 1890, London held a competition to beat the Eiffel Tower. 68 designs came in. Some of them were wonderful.

Full video: "London Almost Built Its Own Eiffel Tower" https://youtu.be/sceWaTQ20rY

Narrated by Eric Hoffman. Every picture is real. Sources and full credits are in the full video's description.
Pictures: the 1890 competition catalogue (public domain), via the Internet Archive.
Music: Chopin, Nocturne Op. 62 No. 1, Musopen (CC0).
